title: Verify successful LTE Attach and Detach procedure for single UE under excellent radio conditions
description: Validate the end-to-end LTE attach and detach procedures with a single UE in excellent radio conditions by powering ON and OFF the UE for 10 iterations.
preconditions: Single cell scenario configured with only one active UE
Serving LTE cell is activated and unloaded, all other cells powered off
UE placed at cell center with LTE RSRP in excellent radio conditions
Test configuration parameters recorded
testSteps: Configure the test setup according to the test configuration parameters
Activate the serving LTE cell and ensure no other cells are active
Place the UE under excellent radio conditions as per LTE RSRP metrics
Start logging call flow and signaling messages
Power ON the UE to initiate LTE attach procedure
Wait for attach success indication (attach complete message)
Verify that UE is attached to the correct LTE cell (check PCI, Global eNB ID, ARFCN)
Power OFF the UE to initiate LTE detach procedure
Wait for detach success indication (detach accept and UE context release messages)
Stop and save logs
Repeat steps 4 to 10 for a total of 10 iterations
Calculate and record attach success rate, detach success rate, and attach latency (min, avg, max) in test report
expectedResults: Attach and detach procedures succeed 10 consecutive times with 100% success rate
UE is attached and detached correctly to/from the specified LTE cell
Attach latency values are within acceptable limits
Logs contain valid signaling messages confirming successful attach and detach
postconditions: UE is detached and test environment restored
verificationMethods: Review UE logs for attach and detach success messages
Analyze call flow and signaling messages captured in logs
Validate radio parameters (LTE RSRP) and cell identity in UE logs

title: Verify successful 5G NSA Attach and Detach procedure including Secondary Node Addition and Release
description: Validate the end-to-end 5G NSA attach, secondary node addition, and detach procedures with a single UE in excellent radio conditions by powering ON and OFF the UE for 10 iterations.
preconditions: Single cell scenario configured with only one active UE
Serving 5G NSA cell is activated and unloaded, all other cells powered off
UE placed at cell center with 5G SS-RSRP in excellent radio conditions
Test configuration parameters recorded
testSteps: Configure the test setup as per the test configuration parameters
Activate the serving 5G NSA cell and ensure no other cells are active
Place the UE under excellent radio conditions as per 5G SS-RSRP metrics
Start logging call flow and signaling messages
Power ON the UE to initiate 5G NSA attach procedure
Wait for attach success indication (attach complete message and SgNB addition complete)
Verify UE attachment to correct LTE and NR cells (check PCI, Global eNB ID, Global gNB ID, ARFCN, NR-ARFCN)
Power OFF the UE to initiate 5G NSA detach procedure including secondary node release
Wait for detach success indication (detach accept, UE context release, and SgNB release messages)
Stop and save logs
Repeat steps 4 to 10 for a total of 10 iterations
Calculate and record attach success rate, secondary node addition success rate, detach success rate in test report
expectedResults: Attach, secondary node addition, and detach procedures succeed 10 consecutive times with 100% success rate
UE is correctly attached to LTE and 5G cells and detached cleanly
Logs contain valid signaling messages confirming successful attach, secondary node addition, and detach including SN release
Secondary node release is confirmed by SgNB Release Request and Acknowledge messages
postconditions: UE is detached and test environment restored
verificationMethods: Review UE logs and signaling traces for attach, secondary node addition, and detach success messages
Validate presence of SgNB Release Request and Acknowledge signaling confirming SN release
Analyze radio parameters (LTE RSRP and 5G SS-RSRP) and cell identities

title: Verify behavior when UE attach request is not acknowledged (Attach failure handling)
description: Test system response when the UE attach request is not acknowledged or times out during LTE or 5G NSA attach procedure.
preconditions: Test setup as per positive test case with active serving cell and single UE
Simulate attach request failure by blocking or dropping attach request messages
testSteps: Start logging call flow and signaling messages
Power ON the UE to initiate attach procedure
Simulate failure by blocking attach request acknowledgement (attach complete) messages
Wait for attach timeout or failure response from the network or UE
Verify UE retries attach procedure or reports attach failure
Stop and save logs
expectedResults: Attach procedure fails gracefully with appropriate error or timeout
UE retries attach after failure or reports failure status
Logs contain failed attach request without attach complete message
No partial attach or inconsistent UE context established
postconditions: Test environment restored to normal operation
verificationMethods: Analyze signaling logs for missing attach complete messages
Check UE logs for attach failure or retry messages
Validate network logs for attach request reception and response behavior

title: Verify behavior when detach request is not acknowledged (Detach failure handling)
description: Test system behavior when the UE detach request is not acknowledged or times out during LTE or 5G NSA detach procedure.
preconditions: UE is attached to the network in LTE or 5G NSA mode
Simulate detach request failure by blocking or dropping detach accept messages
testSteps: Start logging call flow and signaling messages
Power OFF the UE or initiate UE-initiated detach
Simulate failure by blocking detach accept messages from the network
Wait for detach timeout or failure response from the UE or network
Verify system behavior on detach failure (e.g., retries, forced release)
Stop and save logs
expectedResults: Detach procedure fails gracefully with appropriate error or timeout
UE or network retries detach or eventually releases context
Logs show detach request without detach accept
No UE context remains in inconsistent state
postconditions: Test environment restored to normal operation
verificationMethods: Analyze signaling logs for missing detach accept messages
Check UE logs for detach failure or retry messages
Validate network logs for detach request reception and response behavior

title: Attach and Detach procedure test at minimum acceptable coupling loss boundary
description: Validate successful attach and detach procedures when the UE is placed at the boundary of minimum coupling loss as defined by Clause 4.6 for LTE and 5G NSA.
preconditions: Single cell test setup with adjustable radio conditions
UE emulator or real UE capable of measuring RSRP and coupling loss
testSteps: Configure the radio environment to set coupling loss at the minimum acceptable threshold
Place the UE at the configured position with minimum coupling loss
Start logging call flow and signaling messages
Power ON the UE to perform attach procedure
Verify attach success and correct cell attachment
Power OFF the UE to perform detach procedure
Verify detach success and release of resources
Stop and save logs
Repeat for 10 iterations
Record KPIs for attach success rate, detach success rate, and attach latency
expectedResults: Attach and detach procedures succeed 10 consecutive times despite boundary radio conditions
Attach and detach success rates meet 100% target
Attach latency within acceptable limits
No radio or signaling errors due to borderline coupling loss
verificationMethods: Review logs for successful signaling flows
Validate radio measurements at coupling loss threshold
Check KPI values for conformity

title: Attach and Detach procedure test with fluctuating radio conditions around excellent threshold
description: Test attach and detach success when radio conditions vary around the defined excellent RSRP threshold for LTE and 5G NSA.
preconditions: Test setup with variable attenuator or fading generator to emulate radio fluctuations
UE emulator or real UE capable of measuring RSRP and SS-RSRP
testSteps: Configure radio environment to oscillate around excellent RSRP threshold
Place UE in cell center
Start logging call flow and signaling messages
Power ON UE and perform attach procedure during fluctuating radio conditions
Verify attach success and cell attachment accuracy
Power OFF UE and perform detach procedure
Verify detach success
Stop and save logs
Repeat for 10 iterations
Record attach/detach success rates and attach latency
expectedResults: Attach and detach procedures succeed across fluctuating radio conditions
Success rates remain at or near 100%
No signaling errors or connection drops due to minor RSRP fluctuations
verificationMethods: Analyze logs for successful signaling
Review RSRP measurements during test
Validate KPI adherence

title: Performance test: Measure attach latency and success rate for 10 iterations under excellent radio conditions
description: Measure and record attach latency (min, max, average) and attach/detach success rates for 10 consecutive attach-detach cycles with a single UE.
preconditions: Test setup with single serving cell and one active UE under excellent radio conditions
Logging and measurement tools enabled
testSteps: Configure test environment and record parameters
Activate serving cell, power ON UE to trigger attach
Measure and log attach request and attach complete timestamps for each iteration
Power OFF UE to trigger detach
Measure and log detach request and accept timestamps
Repeat attach-detach sequence 10 times
Calculate attach latency for each iteration
Sort latency values ascending and record min, max, and average latency
Calculate attach and detach success rates
expectedResults: Attach and detach success rates are 100%
Attach latency values meet or exceed defined targets
Consistent latency across iterations with no outliers
No failure events recorded
postconditions: UE detached and test logs saved
verificationMethods: Analyze timing stamps in logs
Calculate latency metrics
Review success/failure events in signaling

title: Verify attach and detach procedure with authentication failure
description: Test system response when the UE fails authentication during attach procedure, ensuring security handling and rejection.
preconditions: Test environment configured with authentication failure scenario (e.g., invalid credentials or security keys)
Single serving cell active
testSteps: Power ON UE to initiate attach procedure
Simulate authentication failure scenario in network or UE
Monitor attach procedure progress and messages
Verify that attach is rejected due to authentication failure
Attempt detach procedure if attach partially succeeds
Capture logs and signaling messages
expectedResults: Attach procedure fails with authentication rejection message
UE does not attach to network
Security logs record authentication failure event
No unauthorized access granted
postconditions: Test environment reset to normal authentication
verificationMethods: Review attach reject messages in signaling
Check security logs for authentication failure
Validate UE status as detached

title: Integration test: Validate signaling and data forwarding coordination during Secondary Node Release (SN Release)
description: Verify that the signaling and data forwarding coordination happen correctly between Master Node (MN) and Secondary Node (SN) during SN Release procedure initiated by MN and SN.
preconditions: 5G NSA setup with MN and SN configured
UE attached with active secondary node
Logging enabled for signaling and data forwarding events
testSteps: Initiate SN Release procedure from MN by sending SgNB Release Request message
Verify SN sends SgNB Release Request Acknowledge message
Check RRCConnectionReconfiguration message instructing UE to release SCG
Validate SN sends SN Status Transfer message and Secondary RAT Data Usage Report
Confirm data forwarding from SN to MN starts and ends properly
Verify SN releases UE context upon UE Context Release message
Repeat procedure with SN initiated SN Release by SN sending SgNB Release Required message
Observe MN sending SgNB Release Confirm message
Verify all signaling and data forwarding coordination steps as above
Capture and analyze all signaling messages and timing coordination
expectedResults: All signaling messages exchanged as per 3GPP TS 37.340 Clause 10.4.1
Data forwarding starts and ends in coordination with signaling
UE receives RRCConnectionReconfiguration and releases SCG as expected
No gaps or inconsistencies in service during release
UE context successfully released at SN
verificationMethods: Analyze signaling traces for SgNB Release Request and Acknowledge messages
Validate timing between data forwarding and signaling messages
Check UE logs for RRCConnectionReconfiguration and SCG release
Review SN context release confirmation

testSteps: Perform attach and detach test iterations as per procedure

Verify that logs capture all relevant call flow and signaling messages
Confirm that logs are saved in accessible and organized format
Validate documentation clarity for later analysis
expectedResults: All test configuration parameters are accurately recorded
Logs contain complete and consistent data for each iteration
Test report and logs are easy to interpret and analyze
No missing or ambiguous information
verificationMethods: Review test report for completeness
Audit saved logs for content and organization
Confirm accessibility and readability of documentation

title: Compatibility test: Validate attach and detach behavior across different UE emulator platforms
description: Verify that the attach and detach procedures succeed with different UE emulators or real UE devices under identical test configurations.
preconditions: Test environment configured for single cell with excellent radio conditions
Multiple UE emulators or devices available
testSteps: Select first UE emulator and perform 10 attach-detach iterations following test procedure
Record KPIs and validate success
Repeat test with second UE emulator or real UE device
Compare results across devices
Check for any discrepancies or issues specific to platform
expectedResults: Attach and detach success rates are consistent across different UE platforms
KPIs such as attach latency are within acceptable variance
No platform-specific failures or anomalies observed
verificationMethods: Compare KPIs and success rates from each device
Review logs for platform-specific errors or warnings
Validate consistent behavior across platforms
